exercises.instructionEn: Use the adverbs of frequency and the prompts below to make sentences about your activities. 0% never - 10% rarely - 25% sometimes - 50% often - 75% usually - 100% always. 1 have a drink / friends / on Friday evenings 2 go / cinema / weekends 3 watch TV / free time 4 play basketball / afternoon 5 get up early / Sundays 6 do / homework / evening
exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlari va quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan o'z mashg'ulotlaringiz haqida gaplar tuzing. 0% never - 10% rarely - 25% sometimes - 50% often - 75% usually - 100% always. 1 have a drink / friends / on Friday evenings 2 go / cinema / weekends 3 watch TV / free time 4 play basketball / afternoon 5 get up early / Sundays 6 do / homework / evening
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI
  (coursebook 14-bet 12-13-mashq).

  ShKALA:
    always    100%  har doim
    usually    75%  odatda
    often      50%  tez-tez
    sometimes  25%  ba'zan
    rarely     10%  kamdan-kam
    never       0%  hech qachon


⚠ O'RNI - ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:

  I ALWAYS get up early.
  She RARELY cooks dinner.
  ⚠ 'be' dan KEYIN: 'He is always
  late.'


⚠ 'NEVER' BILAN INKOR YO'Q:

  'I never go' ('I don't never go'
  - XATO).


⚠ PREDLOGLAR:

  ON Friday evenings, ON Sundays
  AT weekends (Brit.) / ON weekends
  IN my free time, IN the afternoon,
  IN the evening
  TO the cinema


⚠ 'TO HAVE A DRINK':

  = biror narsa ichmoq (kafe).
exercises.exampleEn: I sometimes have a drink with my friends on Friday evenings.
exercises.exampleUz: Men ba'zan juma kunlari kechqurun do'stlarim bilan biror narsa ichaman.
modelAnswers: I sometimes have a drink with my friends on Friday evenings.
I often go to the cinema at weekends.
I usually watch TV in my free time.
I rarely play basketball in the afternoon.
I never get up early on Sundays.
I always do my homework in the evening.
modelAnswersUz: Men ba'zan juma kunlari kechqurun do'stlarim bilan biror narsa ichaman.
Men dam olish kunlari tez-tez kinoga boraman.
Men bo'sh vaqtimda odatda televizor ko'raman.
Men tushdan keyin kamdan-kam basketbol o'ynayman.
Men yakshanba kunlari hech qachon erta turmayman.
Men uy vazifamni har doim kechqurun bajaraman.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the words into the correct order.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'Z TARTIBI - RAVISh FE'LDAN
  OLDIN:

  EGA + RAVISh + FE'L-S + ... +
  VAQT

  Greg + often + goes + fishing +
  at weekends.


⚠ VAQT - GAP OXIRIDA:

  'at weekends', 'on Sundays',
  'on Saturday mornings'.


⚠ 3-ShAXS -S:

  goes, cooks, gets, does, washes,
  wears.
  ⚠ 'I rarely go' - 'I' bilan -S
  yo'q.


⚠ 'TO GO FISHING':

  = baliq oviga bormoq. 'go' +
  V-ing (go swimming, go shopping).


⚠ 'TO GET UP EARLY':

  = erta turmoq.


⚠ 'JEANS AND A T-SHIRT':

  'jeans' - ko'plik (artiklsiz),
  'a T-shirt' - birlik.

items.answer: Greg often goes fishing at weekends.
Carla never gets up early on Sundays.
He sometimes washes the car on Saturday mornings.
Jason usually wears jeans and a T-shirt.
I rarely go to the gym.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'I rarely go' - 'I' bilan -S yo'q. 'go TO THE gym'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in the gaps with the verbs in the list in the correct form: go, enjoy, type, wake up, cook, have, watch, dress, say, catch, arrive, take, finish, answer. (Cindy Mills is a secretary at a large computer company.)
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring: go, enjoy, type, wake up, cook, have, watch, dress, say, catch, arrive, take, finish, answer. (Cindy Mills katta kompyuter kompaniyasida kotiba.)
exercises.explanationUz:
CINDY MILLSNING KUNDALIK TARTIBI
  - PRESENT SIMPLE, 3-ShAXS.

  ⚠ Hamma fe'l 'She' bilan → -S:
  wakes up, has, dresses, catches,
  arrives, types, answers, takes,
  goes, finishes, cooks, watches,
  enjoys, says.


⚠ -ES QO'ShILADIGANLAR:

  dress → dressES (-ss)
  catch → catchES (-ch)
  go → goES (-o)
  finish → finishES (-sh)
  watch → watchES (-ch)


⚠ 'SAY' → 'SAYS':

  Imlo: 'says' (unli + y → +s).
  ⚠ Talaffuz /sez/ ('seyz' EMAS!).


⚠ 'ENJOY' → 'ENJOYS':

  unli + y → +s. 'enjoy + V-ing':
  'enjoys reading'.


⚠ 'TO DRESS':

  = kiyinmoq. 'dresses quickly' =
  tez kiyinadi.


⚠ 'TO TYPE':

  = klaviaturada yozmoq. 'types
  letters' = xatlar yozadi.


⚠ 'TO ANSWER THE PHONE':

  = telefonga javob bermoq.


⚠ 'TO TAKE A BREAK':

  = tanaffus qilmoq ('take' bilan).


⚠ 'NEXT DOOR':

  = qo'shni (binoda).


⚠ 'THE PAY':

  = maosh, ish haqi.

items.sentence: She ___ quickly, and leaves her house at a quarter past eight.
items.uz: U tez kiyinadi va sakkizdan chorak o'tganda uyidan chiqadi.

items.sentence: and ___ at work just before nine o'clock.
items.uz: va to'qqizdan sal oldin ishga yetib keladi.

items.sentence: She makes a cup of coffee, then sits down to read the mail. She ___ letters
items.uz: U bir piyola qahva damlaydi, so'ng pochtani o'qishga o'tiradi. U xatlar yozadi
va ertalab davomida telefonga javob beradi.

items.sentence: She ___ a break at half past twelve
items.uz: U o'n ikki yarimda tanaffus qiladi

items.sentence: and ___ to the restaurant next door to have lunch.
items.uz: va tushlik qilish uchun qo'shni restoranga boradi.

items.sentence: She ___ work at five o'clock and usually arrives home at about six.
items.uz: U ishni soat beshda tugatadi va odatda soat olti atrofida uyga keladi.

items.sentence: She ___ dinner at about seven o'clock,
items.uz: U yetti atrofida kechki ovqat pishiradi,

items.sentence: then ___ TV until it's time to go to bed.
items.uz: keyin uxlash vaqti bo'lguncha televizor ko'radi.

items.sentence: In her free time, Cindy ___ reading and going to the theatre.
items.uz: Bo'sh vaqtida Sindi o'qish va teatrga borishdan zavqlanadi.

items.sentence: Cindy likes being a secretary. "I like the people I work with, and the pay is good," she ___ . "Yes, I am happy with my life at the moment."
items.uz: Sindi kotiba bo'lishni yaxshi ko'radi. "Men bilan ishlaydigan odamlar menga yoqadi va maosh yaxshi," deydi u. "Ha, men hozir hayotimdan mamnunman."

exercises.explanationUz:
MATNGA QARAB TUZATISh.

  ⚠ Har gapda BITTA xato - matndan
  to'g'ri faktni toping:

  1 uyg'onadi: 7:30 (8:15 EMAS -
    8:15 da uydan CHIQADI)
  2 ertalab davomida: xatlar yozadi
    va telefonga javob beradi
    (qahva va pochta - faqat
    boshida)
  3 ishdan chiqadi: 5:00 (6:00 da
    UYGA KELADI)
  4 bo'sh vaqtida: o'qish va teatr
    (ovqat pishirish va xat yozish -
    ish/uy vazifasi)
  5 baxtli (unhappy EMAS)


⚠ 'UNHAPPY':

  'un-' = inkor: happy → unhappy.
  Matnda: 'I am happy'.

items.textEn: Cindy wakes up at a quarter past eight. → Cindy wakes up at ___ .
items.hintUz: matn: 'wakes up at half past seven'
items.whyUz: ⚠ 8:15 da u UYDAN ChIQADI, uyg'onadi - 7:30 da.

items.textEn: Cindy makes coffee and reads her mail all morning. → Cindy ___ all morning.
items.answer: types letters and answers the phone
items.hintUz: matn: 'types letters and answers the phone all morning'
items.whyUz: ⚠ Qahva va pochta - faqat ish boshida; ertalab davomida - xatlar va telefon.

items.textEn: Cindy usually leaves work at about six. → Cindy finishes work at ___ .
items.whyUz: ⚠ Soat 6 da u UYGA KELADI; ishni 5 da tugatadi.

items.textEn: Cindy enjoys cooking and typing letters in her free time. → Cindy enjoys ___ in her free time.
items.answer: reading and going to the theatre
items.hintUz: matn: 'enjoys reading and going to the theatre'
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ovqat pishirish va xat yozish - ish/uy yumushi, bo'sh vaqt emas.

items.textEn: Cindy is unhappy with her life at the moment. → Cindy is ___ with her life at the moment.
items.hintUz: matn: 'I am happy with my life'
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'unhappy' → 'happy'. Matnda: 'Yes, I am happy with my life at the moment.'
